text:
Indian benchmarks surged on Thursday, with Sensex gaining over 2,000 points and Nifty reclaiming 24,500 as crude oil eased.

• Sensex closed at 79,310.01, up 2,008.61 points (2.60%); Nifty 50 closed at 24,536.60, up 576 points (2.40%), per DSIJ and ChiniMandi closing reports. Kotak Neo also reports a 2.40% gain for Nifty.
• Nifty Auto rose 4.14% and Nifty Financial Services rose 3.99%, per Kotak Neo and DSIJ. Nifty Midcap 100 rose 1.87% and Nifty Smallcap 100 rose 0.56%.
• Reports cite a roughly 9% fall in Brent crude on 4 November and hopes of easing West Asia tensions after the US midterm results, per DSIJ, Kotak Neo and The United Indian. No formal agreement has been reported.
• FIIs were net buyers of Rs 7,284 crore on 4 November, per DSIJ and The United Indian.

Our view: a one-day move of this size, led by autos and financials, suggests sentiment is sensitive to crude and geopolitical headlines. Such moves can reverse as quickly as they arrive, and one session says little about direction. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: after a sharp one-day rally, which indicators (breadth, volatility, flows) do you watch to judge whether it is being sustained?
